journey.name: Change app language
journey.description: Change the app language from the Appearance settings and verify the UI switches to the selected language. Exercises navigation to Settings and the i18n wiring.

actions.action: Tap the "Profile" entry in the bottom navigation bar
Tap the settings icon in the top app bar
Verify the Settings screen is shown with an "Appearance" item
Verify the interface labels are now shown in Italian
